title: 27 October 2026 source and evidence reconciliation
summary: Grid dev15 and XTP dev30 are newer sources, while ED209 candidate2 remains on older segmented QFXTP. R-11 fixed locally and submitted; R-10 MI-held signature and live 20/20 are still not accepted.
invariants: Generic RTO2 Grid controller 8 MU/16 MI reference is not the active 10 MU/20 MI ED209 estate.

XTP dev26+ destination MAC checks mitigate R-08; promiscuous bridge adversarial field qualification remains unproven.
CODEX-PC REQ-00000513 reports the isolated R-09 adapter test passes denied THROTTLE 0%, missing/invalid RATE_PERCENT; no live estate admission proof.
Controller commit and receipt SHA-256 do not prove R-10 MI-only result origin, because a symmetric key also held by the MU can be used for forgery.
Candidate2 MU wrapper loses native error classifications (R-11); candidate3 adds redacted typed classes and exit-code preservation, locally tested.
R-11 local tests 4/4, guest preflight 6/6, overlay 2/2 passed; the full synthetic 20/20 rerun stalled and does not count as PASS.
RTO2 20/20 live authenticated and controller-committed receipts remain outstanding; no SSH-only or synthetic shortcut can satisfy acceptance.
Memory Fabric XTP candidate4 and Queue Fabric receipt gate candidate1 exist but do not substitute for Grid/Queue durable execution or Storage commit.
